summary: Make the Dispatch dashboard browser tests stop failing on timing in CI: set the suite's assertion timeout once in the Playwright config (15 s), remove every per-assertion one-second budget on a cross-user or server propagation wait, rename the two tests that promise 'within a second', and give each re-run attempt's failure traces a distinct artifact name. The retained traces of the four failures were read; none was a slow server or a slow propagation. Two were a test racing its own write against a reload/navigation (inbox, approval) and two were a real edit loss in the collaborative code block (doc), so the same pull request fixes those two test races and moves the doc scenario's typing out of the code block; the editor bug is tracked as LEGION-135. The tester then proves ten consecutive green attempts of the pull request's workflow run.

Plan and spec content live in Dispatch and .legion/; nothing under docs/plans or docs/superpowers/plans enters the pull request.

tasks.title: Tester: ten consecutive green attempts of the pull request's workflow run
protocol: Find the run: `legion gh -- run list --repo sjawhar/legion --branch legion/LEGION-94 --workflow 'Legion Envoy and Contracts' --limit 5` and pick the run for the pull request's head SHA; attempt 1 must already be green (`legion gh -- run view <run-id> --repo sjawhar/legion` shows the `dispatch` job success).

Repeat nine times: wait for the previous attempt to complete (`legion gh -- run watch <run-id> --repo sjawhar/legion --exit-status`, or poll `legion gh -- api repos/sjawhar/legion/actions/runs/<run-id> --jq '{run_attempt,status,conclusion}'`), then `legion gh -- run rerun <run-id> --repo sjawhar/legion` (the whole run, not `--failed`: a green run has nothing failed to re-run). Do not start a rerun while an attempt is in progress; GitHub refuses it.

For each attempt n in 1..10 record: `legion gh -- api repos/sjawhar/legion/actions/runs/<run-id>/attempts/<n>/jobs --jq '.jobs[] | select(.name=="dispatch") | {id, conclusion, started_at, completed_at}'` and the Browser-test step's log tail (`legion gh -- run view --job <job-id> --repo sjawhar/legion --log | grep -E '^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+ (passed|failed|flaky|skipped)'`). Every attempt: `dispatch` job success, browser step `N passed, M skipped`, no `failed`, no `flaky`.

Any attempt with a failed or flaky scenario: download that attempt's traces by name (`legion gh -- run download <run-id> -n dispatch-e2e-test-results-<n> -D <scratch>` — the new name makes this possible), read the failing scenario's trace as the planner did (test.trace timeline, *-trace.network `wait`, screencast), report the cause to the architect by Envoy message; the count restarts at zero on the head that fixes it. A rerun is never itself the proof.
`legion gh -- run rerun` refused: report the exact command and message to the architect and stop.

Handoff `.legion/test.json` records the run id, attempts 1–10 with each `dispatch` job id and conclusion, and the pass/skip counts; the PR body's E2E line names the run id and 'attempts 1–10 green' with the head SHA. Negative controls (tasks 3 and 4) are recorded in test.json once, not re-pasted per round.
